summary: Table menu: Return to game now closes the menu. The dialog hid only its built-in Close button; the button's row stayed over the bottom of the body and swallowed clicks on Return to game. HideDialogButtons (Main.Dialogs.cs) hides the row too and is used by every dialog that hides its Close button (table menu, both Pass the device curtains, Removed from the Game gallery). New native check tools/check-table-menu-ui.sh opens the menu from its icon and really clicks Return to game.
